metrics.name: words_missing
metrics.threshold: transcript word(s) with recogniser posterior < 0.1 (reference >= 0.5) squeezed below 55 % of the reference duration

regions.explanation: From 64.62s to 65.21s (“man come not”), 1 word(s) of the text were not said (missing: “come”; recognised here: “a man”): the recogniser's confidence in them fell to 0.00 against 0.98 in the reference. Leaving out words changes the text the audience hears; in a prepared reading it is scored as an accuracy error, and a missing function word can change the meaning of the sentence. Fix: Slow down slightly through this line and keep your eyes a phrase ahead of your voice.

fix.edit: the missing “come” restored from the reference reading

regions.text: state but from the hand of God. We dare not forget
regions.explanation: From 67.00s to 75.12s (“state but from the hand of God. We dare not forget”), articulation rate slowed to 2.81 syll/s against 3.88 syll/s in the reference (-28%); that is 1.4× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Stretched words without matching emphasis read as hesitation and dilute the rhythm of the phrase; the audience's attention drifts between content words. Fix: Tighten these words to the reference pace; keep length only on the stressed word.

fix.edit: time-scaled 8.12 s by x0.72 to 3.88 syll/s
